findings.title: Quarterly User Access Reviews Delayed
findings.remediation_evidence: Automated Okta access review workflow implemented.

findings.title: Third-Party Vendor Risk Assessments Missing SOC 2 Reports
findings.remediation_evidence: Collected vendor SOC 2 reports for top 15 critical vendors.

findings.title: Unencrypted RDS Manual Snapshots in Staging AWS Account
findings.remediation_note: Closed after manual snapshot cleanup. No automated KMS enforcement rule put in place.

findings.title: SSH Root Login Enabled on Legacy Bastion Host
findings.remediation_evidence: Disabled SSH root login and migrated to AWS SSM Session Manager.

findings.title: Production Database Logs Lack Centralized Audit Logging
findings.remediation_evidence: Streamed PostgreSQL audit logs to Datadog with 1-year retention.

findings.title: Offboarding Checklist Not Completed Within 24 Hours
findings.remediation_evidence: HR integrated BambooHR termination webhooks with Okta deprovisioning.

findings.title: Missing MFA Requirement for Legacy Staging VPN
findings.remediation_evidence: Enforced SAML 2.0 MFA on AWS Client VPN.

findings.title: Incident Response Plan Lacks Annual Tabletop Testing Documentation
findings.remediation_evidence: Conducted ransomware tabletop exercise on Aug 20, 2023.

findings.title: S3 Buckets Lacking Object Versioning
findings.remediation_evidence: Enabled S3 versioning via Terraform default module.

findings.title: Software Dependency Vulnerability Scanning Absent in CI/CD
findings.remediation_evidence: Integrated Snyk container and dependency scanning into GitHub Actions.

findings.title: GitHub Repositories Allow Direct Pushes to Main Branch
findings.remediation_evidence: Enforced main branch protection rules requiring 1 PR approval across all repos.

findings.title: Production Deployment Approval Lacks Non-Developer Sign-off
findings.remediation_evidence: Updated Jira release pipeline with required QA sign-off gate.

findings.title: Disaster Recovery Plan Recovery Point Objective (RPO) Unverified
findings.remediation_evidence: Executed successful cross-region database failover test.

findings.title: Recurring Unencrypted RDS Snapshots in AWS Production Account
findings.remediation_note: Marked closed after updating Terraform policy documentation. No automated guardrail added.

findings.title: Lack of Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) for Customer Data
findings.remediation_evidence: Published DPIA template and completed assessment for core analytics service.

findings.title: Employee Security Awareness Training Completion Below 80%
findings.remediation_evidence: Achieved 96% completion rate following mandatory Slack reminders.

findings.title: Workstation Disk Encryption Policy Unenforced on Linux Dev Laptops
findings.remediation_evidence: Deployed Kandji / LUKS encryption MDM agent across all developer laptops.

findings.title: Incomplete Physical Access Logs for Primary Datacenter Racks
findings.remediation_evidence: Datacenter provider Equinix automated badge log export via API.

findings.title: Over-privileged Service Account Keys Older Than 90 Days
findings.remediation_evidence: Implemented AWS IAM secret rotation script with 60-day max age.

findings.title: Public S3 Bucket Policy Lacks Explicit Block Public Access Rule
findings.remediation_evidence: Enabled AWS Account-Level Block Public Access.

findings.title: Penetration Test Remediation Exceeded 60-Day SLA for Medium Risk
findings.remediation_evidence: Patched API rate limiting vulnerability in release v3.4.1.

findings.title: KMS Key Rotation Not Enabled for Legacy Analytics Bucket
findings.remediation_evidence: Enabled annual automatic key rotation in AWS KMS for key alias/analytics-s3.

findings.title: Missing Proof of Data Deletion Upon Customer Offboarding
findings.remediation_evidence: Under review by data platform engineering.

findings.title: Production API Logs Transmitted Over Unencrypted HTTP Endpoint
findings.remediation_evidence: Updated FluentBit log shipper configuration to use TLS 1.3 endpoints.

findings.title: Production Kubernetes Cluster Nodes Running EOL Operating System
findings.trap_explanation: Jira ticket SEC-882 was marked 'Done' by engineer, but no upgrade logs or node pool verification evidence was attached.

findings.title: Contractor Agreements Missing Standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA)
findings.remediation_evidence: Legal team sending revised DPA to active contractors.

findings.title: TLS 1.0/1.1 Supported on Legacy External Ingress Controller
findings.remediation_evidence: Updated NGINX ingress TLS security policy to ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06.

findings.title: Policy Violation: Unencrypted Database Snapshots Created in Production
findings.policy_reference: POL-101 v3 Section 4.2 ('All database snapshots must be encrypted using AWS KMS')
findings.trap_explanation: POL-101 v3 states 100% encryption mandatory, but CloudTrail log #8839 shows CreateDBSnapshot call executed with Encrypted=false.

findings.title: Incomplete Disaster Recovery Call Tree Verification
findings.remediation_evidence: Scheduled annual call tree test for May 2025.

findings.title: Customer Data Retention Period Exceeds Revised Regulatory Thresholds
findings.remediation_evidence: Evaluating automated retention cleanup script for customer PII.

findings.title: Overdue High-Risk Finding: Privileged IAM Admin Access Granted Without Time-Bound Expiry
findings.trap_explanation: Critical IAM privilege finding #AUD-402 was due on Feb 10, 2025 and remains open without extension approval.
